FULL TEXT:
CORRIGENDUM
Ref: Advertisement Reference No.: GNLU/AC/FP-02/2026 Dated 16/05/2026
Notice for Extension of Submission of Applications for the Post of DPIIT-IPR Chair
under SPRIHA Scheme
The University had invited applications in the prescribed format from eligible candidates for the
position of IPR Chair under the DPIIT-IPR Chair under SPRIHA Scheme up to 5:00 PM on or
before 5th June, 2026.
It is hereby informed to all concerned that the last date for submission of applications has been
extended up to 5:00 PM on or before 15.06.2026. All other terms and conditions of the
advertisement shall remain unchanged.
